runtime_inputs: current and historical HB full-softmax MoE router probabilities

causal_self_reference.normalization: current raw head minus own-episode baseline median

heads.flow_convergence_failure: late-flow Hellinger path share minus own early baseline
heads.state_action_response_split: positive(front state route jump minus front action route jump) minus own early baseline
heads.cross_chunk_recurrence: maximum lag-1..4 weighted-Jaccard recurrence minus own early baseline

alarm_logic.joint_branch: flow convergence and state-action response are simultaneously extreme
alarm_logic.recurrence_branch: cross-chunk recurrence is extreme for two consecutive scored queries
alarm_logic.head_scale: finite-sample tail confidence against threshold-confirmation successful episode maxima

threshold_confirmation.labels_used: success labels from non-heldout tasks only
threshold_confirmation.selection: smallest detector confidence threshold whose successful-episode alarm rate does not exceed budget

clock_control.selection: earliest fixed query whose threshold-confirmation successful-episode false alarm rate does not exceed the same budget

interpretation.detector_output: healthy-route extremeness confidence, not failure probability
interpretation.post_reveal_precision: empirical heldout failure fraction among alarmed episodes
